name: emw-geometry-mask
label: EMwrap Geometry Mask
help: Create a 3D mask from geometric shapes (sphere, cylinder and box). Each shape has a center and three Euler angles (rot, tilt, psi); the mask is the union of all shapes (1 inside any of them, 0 outside), with an optional soft edge. The box and pixel size of the mask are those of the optional input volume, or the box size below.

params.name: input_volume
params.label: Input volume (optional):
params.help: Optional map: the mask is created on its box and pixel size, and the wizard shows it under the mask. Without it, set the box size below.

params.label: Box size (px)
params.help: Dimensions of the mask in pixels, only used without an input volume.

params.name: angpix
params.label: Pixel size (Å):
params.help: Pixel size written in the mask header. Empty: the one of the input volume (or 1 without it).

params.name: soft_edge
params.label: Soft edge (px):
params.help: Width in pixels of the soft edge added outside the shapes, as relion_mask_create --width_soft_edge: the mask decays from 1 to 0 with a raised cosine over this distance, to avoid sharp edges. 0: a binary mask.

params.name: shapes
params.label: Shapes
params.help:
One row per shape; the mask is the union of all of them. All values are in pixels (center from the first voxel of the box; empty: the center of the box) and the angles in degrees (ZYZ Euler angles, as Relion). Sizes per shape:

*sphere*: radius
*cylinder*: radius and height (along the rotated Z axis)
*box*: size_x, size_y and size_z (along the rotated axes)

Use the wizard to add and edit the shapes over the input volume.
